body:
This release expands Xe3P and MoE support, adds SYCL MLA/KV-cache functionality, improves speculative decoding support, and fixes GDN and FP8 correctness issues.

> **Upgrade note:** PyTorch XPU has been upgraded from `2.14.0+xpu` to **`2.15.0+xpu`**. Use a matching PyTorch XPU environment when installing or building this release. ([#621](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/621))

## Highlights

- **Xe3P MoE:** Add Xe3P grouped GEMM and fused MoE interfaces, plus the `FORCE_XE3P_KERNEL` dispatch override. ([#583](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/583), [#668](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/668))
- **Qwen3.6-35B-A3B:** Add fused routed/shared MoE decode support. ([#670](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/670))
- **MoE interface:** Add activation and output hooks to `XpuFusedMoe.apply`. ([#648](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/648))
- **MLA and KV cache:** Port KV-cache/MLA operations to SYCL, add `skip_scale` support to `concat_and_cache_mla`, and add `cp_gather_cache` for context parallelism. ([#667](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/667), [#665](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/665), [#682](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/682))
- **Speculative decoding:** Refine FlashAttention for adaptive verification and add TopK=3 MoE specializations for Step3. ([#647](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/647), [#653](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/653))
- **Fused QK norm and RoPE:** Select `heads_per_sg` based on token count. ([#641](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/641))
- **Attention coverage:** Add kernel configuration coverage for Qwen2-VL and GLM-4.7-Flash. ([#663](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/663), [#679](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/679))
- **Compact sampling mask:** Support CSR-style source-row offsets through `cu_num_logits` and multiple rows per request, with independent int32/int64 index types. ([#673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/673))

## Bug Fixes

- Fix GDN causal-convolution state offsets for large indices, skip rows with `NULL_BLOCK_ID`, and honor the DeepSeek conv-state layout. ([#658](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/658), [#660](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/660), [#683](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/683))
- Correct dynamic per-tensor FP8 scale rounding and route MXFP8 GEMM with `K == 32` through the block-scale path. ([#650](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/650), [#645](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/645))
- Support bf16/fp16 weights and biases in `fused_input_norm`. ([#672](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/672))
- Default `moe_sum`'s `topk_ids` and `expert_map` to `None`, and remove an overly restrictive total-expert-count assertion. ([#656](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/656), [#655](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/655))

## Build and CI

- Publish a GitHub Releases wheel index and GitHub Pages, and improve per-commit/nightly wheel dependency resolution and output isolation. ([#674](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/674), [#677](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/677), [#681](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/681), [#684](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/684))
- Preserve main-branch CI runs and schedule nightly CI at 18:00 Beijing time. ([#686](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/686))

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.16...release/v0.1.17](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/compare/v0.1.16...release/v0.1.17)
